circuit.name: Full Bridge Centertapped DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Isolated DC-DC converter using a full-bridge primary stage (4 switches) driving a center-tapped transformer. Converts 48V input to 12V isolated output (4:1 transformer ratio). Secondary side features  a center-tap rectifier (2 diodes) with LC filter output. Provides galvanic isolation  and high power capability with reduced primary-side voltage stress.

requirements.requirement: Startup transient from 48V input to 12V isolated output. Full-bridge converter with 4:1 transformer ratio and center-tap rectifier. Measure output voltage at [R_LOAD, pos] (positive output terminal). Verify soft-start behavior, overshoot, and settling time.

environment.description: 15ms simulation for full-bridge startup (2000+ switching cycles at ~100kHz)

data.name: t_settle
data.description: Time when output settles within 5% of target (last crossing)

measurement.description: Output voltage measurement for startup transient analysis

requirements.requirement: Line regulation test: input voltage step from 43V to 53V (Ã‚Â±10% line variation). Measure output voltage deviation and recovery time at [R_LOAD, pos]. Verify regulation within Ã‚Â±2% of 12V target.

data.name: vout_min
data.description: Minimum output voltage during line transient

data.name: vout_max
data.description: Maximum output voltage during line transient

data.name: t_recovery
data.description: Recovery time to within 2% of target (last crossing)

measurement.description: Output voltage measurement for line regulation test

requirements.requirement: Load transient response: step load change from 50% to 100% of rated load. Measure output voltage deviation, undershoot, and recovery time at [R_LOAD, pos]. Verify transient response within specifications.

data.name: vout_min
data.description: Minimum output voltage during load transient (undershoot)

data.name: t_recovery
data.description: Recovery time to within 5% of target (last crossing)

measurement.description: Output voltage measurement for load transient test

requirements.requirement: Efficiency measurement at nominal operating point (48V input, 12V output, rated load). Calculate input power and output power to determine conversion efficiency. Target >85% efficiency for isolated full-bridge topology.

Primary-side switch voltage and current stress analysis. Measure peak voltage across S1-S4 (should not exceed 48V due to full-bridge topology) and peak switch currents. Verify reduced voltage stress compared to half-bridge.

outputs.formula: max(abs([vsw1_peak]), abs([vsw1_min]), abs([vsw2_peak]), abs([vsw2_min]), abs([vsw3_peak]), abs([vsw3_min]), abs([vsw4_peak]), abs([vsw4_min]))
outputs.description: Maximum voltage stress across all switches in volts
Maximum current stress across all switches in amperes
Peak voltage across S1 in volts
Peak voltage across S2 in volts
Peak voltage across S3 in volts
Peak voltage across S4 in volts

requirements.requirement: Transformer primary and secondary current waveforms. Measure primary-side current (at T1 primary windings P1, P2) and secondary-side currents (at T1 secondary windings S1, S2). Verify 4:1 current transformation ratio and magnetizing current.

outputs.description: Peak secondary current in amperes (maximum of both windings)
RMS secondary winding 1 current in amperes

requirements.requirement: Output voltage ripple measurement at steady state. Measure peak-to-peak ripple voltage at [R_LOAD, pos] and inductor current ripple at L_OUT. Verify ripple within acceptable limits for 12V output.

environment.description: 15ms simulation for ripple measurement at steady state

outputs.description: Output voltage ripple in millivolts peak-to-peak

requirements.requirement: Secondary-side rectifier diode stress analysis. Measure peak reverse voltage and forward current through DR1 and DR2 (center-tap rectifier diodes). Verify diode ratings are adequate.

outputs.description: Maximum reverse voltage stress across rectifier diodes in volts
Maximum forward current stress across rectifier diodes in amperes
Average forward current through DR1 in amperes
Average forward current through DR2 in amperes
